items.informal_name: Non-negativity of Finite Sums in Ordered Additive Monoids
items.type:
∀ {α : Sort u_4} {M : Type u_7} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M] [IsOrderedAddMonoid M] {f : α → M},
  (∀ (i : α), 0 ≤ f i) → 0 ≤ ∑ᶠ (i : α), f i
items.informal_description: In an ordered additive commutative monoid $M$, if every element $f(i)$ in a function $f : \alpha \to M$ satisfies $0 \leq f(i)$, then the finite sum $\sum^\mathrm{fin}_{i : \alpha} f(i)$ is also non-negative, i.e., $0 \leq \sum^\mathrm{fin}_{i : \alpha} f(i)$.

items.informal_name: Non-Negativity of Sum over Finite Set in Additive Commutative Monoid
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι}
  [AddLeftMono N], (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ f i) → 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f i
items.informal_description: Let $\iota$ be an index type and $N$ an additive commutative monoid equipped with a partial order $\leq$ where addition is left-monic. For any finite set $s \subseteq \iota$ and function $f : \iota \to N$, if $0 \leq f(i)$ for all $i \in s$, then the sum $\sum_{i \in s} f(i)$ satisfies $0 \leq \sum_{i \in s} f(i)$.

items.informal_name: Non-negativity of Sum in Additive Commutative Monoid with Partial Order
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid N] [inst_1 : PartialOrder N] {f : ι → N} {s : Finset ι}
  [AddLeftMono N], (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ f i) → 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f i
items.informal_description: In an additive commutative monoid $N$ equipped with a partial order and left-addition monotonicity, if all elements $f(i)$ for $i$ in a finite set $s$ are non-negative, then the sum of $f(i)$ over $s$ is also non-negative.

items.informal_name: Non-Negativity of Finite Sums in Ordered Additive Monoids
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : PartialOrder M] [AddLeftMono M]
  {f : ι → M}, 0 ≤ f → 0 ≤ ∑ i, f i
items.informal_description: For any finite set $\iota$ and an additive commutative monoid $M$ equipped with a partial order $\leq$ where addition is left-monotonic, if each element $f(i)$ of a function $f : \iota \to M$ satisfies $0 \leq f(i)$, then the sum $\sum_{i \in \iota} f(i)$ is also non-negative, i.e., $0 \leq \sum_{i \in \iota} f(i)$.

items.informal_name: Non-Negativity of Sum of Finite Support Functions in Ordered Additive Monoid
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] {f : ι →₀ α} {h₁ : ι → α → β}, (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ h₁ i (f i)) → 0 ≤ f.sum h₁
items.informal_description: For any finite support function $ f : \alpha \to₀ M $ in an ordered additive commutative monoid $ M $, if each value $ f(i) $ is non-negative (i.e., $ 0 \leq f(i) $ for all $ i $), then the sum of $ f $ is also non-negative (i.e., $ 0 \leq \sum f $).
